requested_elements.source_excerpt: un chat saute sur un canapé
requested_elements.visual_evidence: A feline mid-air with hind legs extended downward and front paws reaching forward, approaching the seat cushion of a sofa.
The cat's body is arched in a landing trajectory, not yet fully flattened on the surface, indicating the transition from jump to rest.

construction: A single feline subject is captured mid-air descending toward a sofa. The cat's hind legs are fully extended downward while front paws reach forward, establishing a diagonal trajectory. The body forms an inverted 'U' shape due to the landing impulse. The head faces slightly left with ears perked. The sofa consists of a rectangular seat block and a vertical backrest behind it. The cat's center of mass is positioned just above the seat cushion surface. No facial features or fur texture are rendered; only geometric blocks define the anatomy and furniture. The background is a flat plane to the right of the subject.
frame_subject: A cat jumping onto a sofa, captured in the instant before landing
scale_relationships: The cat's total height is approximately 0.6 times the height of the sofa seat cushion.
The length of the cat's body from nose to tail tip is roughly equal to the width of the sofa seat.
contacts: The cat's hind paws are near-contacting the air just above the sofa seat surface.
The front paws are approaching the front edge of the sofa seat cushion.
spatial_relations: The cat is positioned in front of and slightly below the horizontal plane of the sofa seat.
The sofa backrest is located directly behind the seat cushion.
